description: React component for rendering size-aware images with utility buttons, including copy link and download, handling image load/error states, and responsive layout adjustments.

classes.name: SizeAwareImage
classes.description: React component class for size-aware image rendering with utility overlays and load/error handling.

methods.name: dimensionsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if dimensions object has valid width and height.

methods.name: isSmallImage
methods.description: Determines if an image is considered small based on width and height thresholds.

methods.name: handleLoad
methods.description: Handles image load event, updates state, and triggers callback with image dimensions.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles image load error, updates state, and triggers callback.

methods.name: handleImageClick
methods.description: Handles click event on the image, invokes onClick callback.

methods.name: onEnterKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard 'Enter' key press for accessibility, triggers onClick callback.

methods.name: renderImageLoaderIfNeeded
methods.description: Renders loading indicator if image is not yet loaded and showLoader is true.

methods.name: renderImageWithContainerIfNeeded
methods.description: Renders the image with optional utility buttons and container styling based on size and context.

methods.name: renderImageOrFallback
methods.description: Renders the image or a fallback preview if dimensions are available and image is not loaded.

methods.name: isInternalImage
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the image is internal based on fileInfo presence.

methods.name: startCopyTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer to reset the 'linkCopiedRecently' state after 1.5 seconds.

methods.name: copyLinkToAsset
methods.description: Copies the image link or public URL to clipboard, manages copy state and API call.
